why: A case listed here is one the Elixir client has no surface for, not one that fails. Each reason names the missing function, so the entry stops being true the moment the SDK grows it and the case starts reporting a real status.

None of these were reached on 2026-08-13: Postgrex cannot complete a connection to Nucleus at all (its type bootstrap selects from pg_range, which the engine's pg_catalog does not implement), so every case fails before its first statement. They are recorded from reading elixir/lib/nucleus/models/, and become live results the moment the connection works.

2026-08-15: six of the seven entries removed after the missing SDK surface was implemented — Document.find/find_one/update_where/delete_where/path_all, Blob bucket forms + exists, Vector.count, TimeSeries.aggregate. They are now live results, not declarations. timeseries.range_query remains: raw point retrieval is a cross-SDK contract question (three SDKs give three answers), not a missing Elixir function.
